summary: Quiet ORBAT rows recede, map callsigns show on demand, and repeated log reports merge.
rationale: Full-width, normal-speed gameplay makes the partial-scroll hover mapping, quiet/urgent hierarchy and later repeated report readable. First three seconds show the old hover mismatch; the next nine show the updated controls. Cued actions and reports are disclosed in motion-capture.json. Retains the original comparison sheet. Software capture is not a performance measurement.

original_still_provenance.rationale: Matched native-pixel crops of the same frames show the order of battle, log and map labels before and after; hover behaviour is covered by the UI layout test, not a still.
